Name: SNES Twinbee Bells
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
hello i have been playing a lot of rainbow bell adventures

this mod adds a tree based upon the bell clouds from the twinbee games. it will produce various bell fruits for you in seasons other than winter. each bell can be eaten to get a buff. they also can be processed same as other fruits. you can choose if you want the tree's cloud to have a face or not. buy the rainbow bell at pierre's to plant. pretty simple mod.

if i ever get around to figuring out how to do it, i'll add a berry bush that makes mini bells too.

Downloads.Description: Adds a tree that produces bell fruits with various buffs
